description: PROACTIVE. Search commercial cruises for a departure port and/or destination and an explicit departure date range. Preserve every location constraint supplied by the user: when both a departure port and destination are supplied, pass BOTH (for example, Caribbean cruises from Miami requires departurePort=Miami and destination=Caribbean). Ask for missing location or dates; never invent them. Returns cruise cards with observed starting prices and booking links. Prices may change and are not confirmed bookings; do not promise cabin availability, inclusions or a final party total. If searchStatus is unavailable, explain that search could not run, not that no cruises exist. Summarize briefly without duplicating the cards. Do not use for saved cruise reservations, itinerary edits, or private sailing journeys.

departurePort.description: Departure port. Always include it when the user supplies one, including when destination is also supplied. Use null only when no departure port was supplied. At least one location field must be non-null.

destination.description: Cruise destination or region. Always include it when the user supplies one, including when departurePort is also supplied. Use null only when no destination was supplied. At least one location field must be non-null.

name: search_cruises
title: Search Cruises
